courses.name: Moore Park Golf
courses.address: Cnr Anzac Parade and Cleveland Street, Moore Park NSW 2021
courses.notes: 10 holes, par 38, while the course is rebuilt: since 1 July 2026 it plays holes 1–10 of the old 18-hole layout, from the old first tee, inside new fences (20 ha of the old course is becoming Moore Park South park). The club says an interim 12-hole layout opens Monday 2 November 2026, adding two temporary holes, and that the number of holes will change through construction (never under 9) until the final 12-hole course by architect design opens, expected 2027–2028. When the two temporary holes are published, add them to this card (holes 11 and 12) from the club's card; this app's card can be 9, 10, 12 or 18 holes. Lengths in metres from the club's own course page (Hole 1–10 stats: blue, white, then the women's red tee), which agree with GolfNSW's blue 156 m / white 144 m / red 123 m for the 10th. Stroke index: the club's 18-hole men's index for holes 1–10 (2, 18, 7, 3, 14, 12, 16, 5, 10, 8) re-ranked 1–10, so hole 1 is the hardest of the ten and hole 2 the easiest; Offcourse lists a different 18-hole order (3, 18, 10, 2, 12, 16, 6, 7, 14, 4). No handicap rating stored: the only published ratings are for the old 18 holes (blue 70 / 116, white 69 / 114, red women's 71.5 / 116, from Offcourse) and a 10-hole card can't be scored for the handicap estimate here; rounds will be listed as not counting. Green fees are for 12 holes (the club's price table, Oct 2026): Mon–Thu $42, Fri–Sun $50, twilight from 5pm $27 / $33; cart $43, pull buggy $6, club hire $38 / $50 premium. Book online (MiClub public calendar) or call the pro shop, 02 9663 1064. Driving range (Trackman, up to 90 bays planned) and clubhouse stay open throughout.
